image_title: Consolidated Financial Data - Third Quarter, Fiscal 2026
summary: This table presents the consolidated statement of comprehensive income for Infosys for the three months ended December 31, 2025, compared to the same period in 2024, along with a nine-month summary. Key metrics include revenues, cost of sales, gross profit, operating profit, and net profit, with growth percentages indicating year-over-year and quarter-over-quarter changes. Notably, revenues increased by 3.2% year-over-year, while operating profit saw a decline of 11.0%. The operating margin decreased from 21.3% to 18.4%, and net profit also dropped by 7.2%. The table further details adjustments made to reported IFRS financial measures, highlighting the impact of labor codes on operating profit and net profit.
